class.name: OcgShapeupgradeFacedivide
class.brief_description: Divides a Face (both edges in the wires, by splitting curves and pcurves, and the face itself, by splitting supporting surface) according to splitting criteria. * The domain of the face to divide is defined by the PCurves of the wires on the Face.
class.description: ! Divides a Face (both edges in the wires, by splitting ! curves and pcurves, and the face itself, by splitting ! supporting surface) according to splitting criteria. ! * The domain of the face to divide is defined by the PCurves ! of the wires on the Face. ! ! * all the PCurves are supposed to be defined (in the parametric ! space of the supporting surface). ! ! The result is available after the call to the Build method. ! It is a Shell containing all the resulting Faces. ! ! All the modifications made during splitting are recorded in the ! external context (ShapeBuild_ReShape).

method.name: SetSurfaceSegmentMode
method.description: Purpose sets mode for trimming (segment) surface by wire UV bounds.

method.name: Perform
method.description: Performs splitting and computes the resulting shell The context is used to keep track of former splittings in order to keep sharings. It is updated according to modifications made. The optional argument <theArea> is used to initialize the tool for splitting surface in the case of splitting into N parts where N is user-defined.

method.name: SplitSurface
method.description: Performs splitting of surface and computes the shell from source face. The optional argument <theArea> is used to initialize the tool for splitting surface in the case of splitting into N parts where N is user-defined.

method.name: SplitCurves
method.description: Performs splitting of curves of all the edges in the shape and divides these edges.

method.name: Result
method.description: Gives the resulting Shell, or Face, or Null shape if not done.

method.name: Status
method.description: Queries the status of last call to Perform OK : no splitting was done (or no call to Perform) DONE1: some edges were split DONE2: surface was split DONE3: surface was modified without splitting FAIL1: some fails encountered during splitting wires FAIL2: face cannot be split

method.name: SetSplitSurfaceTool
method.description: Sets the tool for splitting surfaces.

method.name: SetWireDivideTool
method.description: Sets the tool for dividing edges on Face.

method.name: GetSplitSurfaceTool
method.description: Returns the tool for splitting surfaces. This tool must be already initialized.

method.name: GetWireDivideTool
method.description: Returns the tool for dividing edges on Face. This tool must be already initialized.
